plan.title: Phone app: Set up the phone app QR in Settings > Anywhere
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

narratives.Problem: The Set up a phone dialog in Settings -> Anywhere only sets up the Tailscale PWA. The native Overdeck app (epic PAN-4823) pairs by scanning a QR that carries this machine's environment id, machine public key and a one-time odp_ pairing code, and needs the machine to be signed in to overdeck.ai. There is no place in the dashboard that shows that QR or lists the phones paired with this machine.
narratives.Proposal: Define the pair-link string ai.overdeck.app:/pair#v=1&e=<environmentId>&k=<machineKeyHex>&c=<odp_code> once, in @overdeck/contracts (buildPhonePairLink). Turn SetUpPhoneDialog into a tab shell: a new first tab 'Overdeck app' (SetUpPhoneAppPanel: store links, the overdeck.ai sign-in gate read from GET /api/directory, the QR built from GET /api/environment and POST /api/pairing/credentials, and PairedPhonesList with Remove via DELETE /api/devices/:id) and the unchanged PWA flow as 'Browser on the phone'. Update configuration/phone.mdx. No server change. PRD: .pan/drafts/PAN-4836.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to the PWA flow's behavior or text
- No QR parser and no apps/mobile code (PAN-4837)
- No server, route or environment-descriptor change; no new no-loss-matrix row
- No configuration/phone-app.mdx and no anywhere.mdx pricing text (PAN-4842)
- No real App Store id (PAN-4841)
- No removal of the duplicate QrImage/expiresInText in PairDeviceDialog.tsx or the dialog's private QrImage
- No change to DevicesPanel.tsx

autoDecisions.summary: Read environmentId and machineKey from GET /api/environment via a new loadEnvironment() in anywhereApi.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The descriptor is unauthenticated and carries both values; AnywhereStatus has no machine key and is null when identity is unreadable.

autoDecisions.summary: Gate the QR on DirectoryResponse.signedIn only; show non-blocking notes for refused/connecting/off
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue and epic AC-8 require sign-in; directory socket state can recover within the 10-minute code lifetime.

autoDecisions.summary: Put buildPhonePairLink and the format regexes in packages/contracts/src/phone-pairing.ts
autoDecisions.rationale: The QR text is a cross-component wire format the phone app (PAN-4837) must parse byte for byte; one definition prevents drift (epic NFR-1 spirit).

autoDecisions.summary: Google Play link derived from the package id; App Store link points at https://overdeck.ai/configuration/phone-app until PAN-4841 creates the App Store record
autoDecisions.rationale: Apple's numeric app id does not exist yet and must not be invented; both URLs are exported constants so PAN-4841 changes one line.

autoDecisions.summary: New SetUpPhoneAppPanel.tsx and PairedPhonesList.tsx; existing body becomes BrowserPhoneSetup in the same dialog file
autoDecisions.rationale: Keeps the PWA flow byte-identical in behavior, keeps files small, and lets each new component carry its own test.

autoDecisions.summary: Use the shared ViewToggle for the tabs and the shared QrImage (with an added data-qr-value attribute) in the new panel
autoDecisions.rationale: Reuses existing components instead of adding a third QR or tab implementation; data-qr-value lets tests assert the encoded text.

autoDecisions.summary: Docs: update configuration/phone.mdx 'Set up a phone' only
autoDecisions.rationale: PAN-4842 owns phone-app.mdx and the wider docs sweep; linking a page that does not exist yet would add a dead link.

items.title: Define the phone app pair-link format in @overdeck/contracts

narrative.Action: PRD .pan/drafts/PAN-4836.md work item W-1. Create packages/contracts/src/phone-pairing.ts exactly as the PRD snippet shows (contracts style: double quotes, no semicolons): PHONE_APP_SCHEME = "ai.overdeck.app", PHONE_PAIR_LINK_VERSION = 1, PHONE_PAIR_LINK_PREFIX = "ai.overdeck.app:/pair#" (single slash), PHONE_PAIR_ENVIRONMENT_ID_RE (lowercase UUID v4, same as UUID_V4_LOWERCASE in src/lib/environment-identity.ts:32), PHONE_PAIR_MACHINE_KEY_RE /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/, PHONE_PAIR_CODE_RE /^odp_[0-9a-f]{64}$/, interface PhonePairLinkInput { environmentId, machineKeyHex, code }, and buildPhonePairLink(input) which validates each field (throwing an Error naming the field) and returns `ai.overdeck.app:/pair#v=1&e=<environmentId>&k=<machineKeyHex>&c=<code>` with no URL encoding. Add `export * from "./phone-pairing"` to packages/contracts/src/index.ts after the connect-view export (line 43). Write packages/contracts/src/__tests__/phone-pairing.test.ts with the PRD's ENV/KEY/CODE fixtures. Do not write a parser (PAN-4837 owns it).

items.title: Given ENV '0b5c6c1e-3f2a-4d8e-9a7b-1c2d3e4f5a6b', KEY 'ab' x32 and CODE 'odp_' + 'cd34' x16, when buildPhonePairLink is called, then it returns exactly 'ai.overdeck.app:/pair#v=1&e=' + ENV + '&k=' + KEY + '&c=' + CODE
Given the returned link, then it starts with 'ai.overdeck.app:/pair#' and contains no '://'
Given an uppercase machine key, a 63-character key, a non-v4 UUID, or a code without the odp_ prefix, when buildPhonePairLink is called, then it throws an Error
Given buildPhonePairLink and PHONE_PAIR_LINK_PREFIX imported from the '@overdeck/contracts' index in the test, then both are defined and PHONE_PAIR_LINK_PREFIX equals 'ai.overdeck.app:/pair#'

narrative.Action: PRD W-3. (1) anywhereApi.ts: add ANYWHERE_ENVIRONMENT_QUERY_KEY ['anywhere-environment'], fetchEnvironment() (GET /api/environment), loadEnvironment() typed EnvironmentDescriptor from @overdeck/contracts, and pairingExpiresInText(expiresAt) with the text 'Expires in N minute(s) · works once' (copy of SetUpPhoneDialog.tsx:54-57). (2) QrImage.tsx: add data-qr-value={link} to the img, nothing else. (3) New SetUpPhoneAppPanel.tsx exporting GOOGLE_PLAY_URL = 'https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=ai.overdeck.app', APP_STORE_URL = 'https://overdeck.ai/configuration/phone-app' (comment: PAN-4841 swaps it to https://apps.apple.com/app/id<n> once the App Store record exists) and SetUpPhoneAppPanel(). Section '1. Install the Overdeck app' with text and 'Google Play' / 'App Store' links (target=_blank rel=noreferrer). Section '2. Scan the pairing code with the app': directory query (DIRECTORY_QUERY_KEY, loadDirectory, refetchInterval 5000); environment query enabled only when signedIn. Loading 'Checking the overdeck.ai sign-in…'; error 'Could not check the overdeck.ai sign-in: <message>'; signedIn false -> p data-testid="phone-app-signed-out" 'Sign in to overdeck.ai on this machine first: pan account login' (pan account login in font-mono span) and nothing else. Signed in: refused+refusal -> refusal text (text-warning-foreground); connecting/off -> 'This machine is not connected to overdeck.ai right now. A phone can pair once it is.'; neither blocks. Environment error or missing machineKey -> 'Could not read this machine's identity: <message>' ('no machine key' when absent), no button. Otherwise 'Create pairing code' calls issuePairingLink(); 403 -> 'Pairing codes can be created only from a browser on this machine.'; other errors -> apiError text; success -> QrImage link=buildPhonePairLink({environmentId, machineKeyHex: machineKey, code: credential}) alt 'Overdeck app pairing QR code' (builder throw -> show its message, no QR), pairingExpiresInText, 'Create another code'; expiry via useEffect+setTimeout -> 'This code expired.' + 'Create another code'. Section 3 renders <PairedPhonesList />. Must not import from SetUpPhoneDialog.tsx. Append 'src/components/Settings/anywhere/__tests__/SetUpPhoneAppPanel.test.tsx' to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt before SetUpPhoneDialog.test.tsx.
